description: `serve.json: {"trailingSlash": true, "cleanUrls": false}` → extensionless, non-dotfile paths get a 301 to `path + "/"`. `cleanUrls` is explicitly disabled so the cleanUrls 301 (Stage 6c) cannot mask or compose with the trailingSlash redirect. The anti-redirect anchor uses `data.txt` (extension exempt, served directly) to verify phase 5 does not fire when it should not. The double-slash anchors verify the multi-slash override from `serve-handler/src/index.js:158-160`: when trailingSlash is set and the (decoded) path contains `//`, the reference emits a 301 to the slash-collapsed form regardless of the add/strip branches — backs SRV-ROUT-005's coupling with phase 5. Backs SRV-ROUT-003 and SRV-ROUT-005.
